description: Trending tokens on Base now: the tokens with the most DEX swaps in the last minutes (default 5, up to 10), counted live from Uniswap v2/v3, Aerodrome and Slipstream Swap events, with swaps, pools, share of swaps, symbol, name and busiest pool. Majors (WETH, USDC, cbBTC, stables) are left out unless asked; symbolClash marks copied symbols, so match by address. Use to spot what traders buy now; check token_report before trading. Example: blocks=150. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

blocks.description: How many recent Base blocks to count, 30 to 300 (default 150, about 5 minutes; a block every 2 s)

majors.description: include to keep WETH, USDC, cbBTC and stables in the list (default: left out)
